sampling.mandatory: All40 M7A packets in frozen manifest order; two GPU_replay samples remain Train
sampling.extension_trigger: Pre-inference inventory:38/40 recorded-target empty; only2 visible actor-views. Insufficient class/direction/range support
sampling.extension_rule: For each of38 M5O groups, sort rows with at least one historical visible_eligible actor by configuration/frame; select rounded quantile ranks0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8. Deduplicate sample_id, union mandatory40. No model output used
sampling.smoke: First all40 core, report absence of Person/Cone/near support. Additional fixed coverage smoke is earliest supplemental Train row for each requested class/direction/range/Town bucket; no inference-based selection

matching.reference: Recorded CARLA Actor OBB center, not contact or precise render mesh
matching.GT_support: Historical M5O seed101 visible actor-views deduplicated into sample/Actor. Renderer instance-AABB association proxy; require >=3 supported pixels. Original and crop-retained denominators reported separately
matching.natural: Score-ordered one-to-one same coarse class 3D center association with XY<=2m and abs(Z)<=2m;4mXY sensitivity separate. All300 topK retained. Benchmark FP means unmatched to recorded annotation, physicalFP unknown
matching.conditional: Independent one-to-one maximum projected2D-box IoU over reliably visible views, IoU>=0.1 and coarse class match, no center distance cutoff. Raw topK and score0.1 both reported. This is image-projection association proxy, not identity proof
matching.pairing: Same GT Actor-view intersection for conditional localization only; union and each-method misses accompany intersection. Both legacy seeds101/102 retained. GeometryPrior/Direct/Plane frozen historical predictions, no retraining
matching.unknown: No detection or unmatched annotation never implies safe Free

risk.rule: Choose lowest threshold satisfying all requirements on independent Calibration; else reject-all/no qualified risk threshold. Sealed never selects anything
risk.uncertainty: Location-cluster descriptive bootstrap, seed8082,1000 draws when >=3groups. No iid frame/pixel interpretation; no new blind final set

class_support: minimum20 GT actors across3groups for descriptive stratum; no generalization certification regardless

time.offline_delivery: Always control_authorized=false; original simulation timestamps never replaced with wall clock
time.latency: All stages separately; CUDA synchronize. Cold first image plus steady remaining, disk/cache state disclosed; no sharedGPU test
